<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/git/bootstrap/acknowledge-protection-failure"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



`protect_branches` fails on a private repository on the free plan, and the wizard warns about this BEFOREHAND. Without this exit the only button was "Try again", which always fails for the same reason — and `provision_failed` makes the dashboard redirect the project back to the provisioning page, leaving it unreachable forever. Only a failure in PROTECTING can be acknowledged: it is the last step and the only one whose failure leaves a usable repository. The product's merge lock (RN-006) doesn't depend on the provider's protection and keeps applying.
